checks.name: Android WebRTC screen capture source review
checks.observation: GetUserMediaImpl assigns DEFAULT_FPS=30 to VideoCapturerInfoEx and exposes it in track.settings. OrientationAwareScreenCapturer.startCapture accepts but ignores its framerate argument, and its VirtualDisplay path has no 30 FPS pacing. Therefore the metadata default alone does not establish a 30 FPS source cap or explain the reported Android receiver decode rate.
